answer: One karst survey slot per identity costs a 60-credit deposit. Each epoch the agent files a dune sand-shift survey; a jury re-walks one slot in ten against the marble tally, and a mismatch burns the deposit. Filing costs 40 for the first, 40+6(k-1) for the k-th; 1,000 fakes pay 3,037,000 for a 40,000 pool. A rented slot fails at the re-walk: the borrowed survey burns both bonds. An honest agent pays 40 once and keeps its deposit.
